purpose: Test whether restricting adaptation prevents the tuning geometry degradation from full-network balanced teacher training while retaining learned mode recall.
intervention: Freeze all parameters except the last four DiT blocks and output adaptive normalization/projection. Conditioning, pair track, pair-bias projection, input projection, time embedding, position embedding and earlier blocks remain frozen. Hash every frozen state tensor before and after training and in EMA. Keep model training mode and existing dropout/noise behavior.

Same source initialization, labels, target schedule, label choices, noise, optimization hyperparameters and evaluation. Clipping acts on the trainable subset and is part of the intervention. Do not claim that this isolates a particular representation's causal role.
